points.description: States that the function signature includes the name of the function.
States that the function signature includes the types of the parameters. Equivalent wording such as 'the data type of each argument' earns the mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for stating both the function name and the types of the parameters, in any equivalent wording. Award 2.5 for each point, and no marks for a point that is missing or wrong. Do not require the parameter names or the return type, since the model answer does not include them.
